attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 12, `tnaC` to `yidA`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 11% of calls. The model names 88 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 1, `mnmE`, 88%.

**A fork follows at `yidX`**, column 13, carried by 71%. Then the `dgo` genes, columns 14 to 18, [[galactonate catabolism]], carried by 89 to 93%, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 91 to 92%. Through columns 53 to 59 a branch of 7 shell families runs in 15 to 16%, [[fructose transport and aldolases]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 86%, and hesitates less there, 0.25 against 0.64 bits. It hesitates most at column 52, `yicJ`, a fork column, 1.38 bits.

**The window ends in the `rfa` genes**, columns 77 to 79, [[lipopolysaccharide core]]. The last column is `rfaP`, in 25% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 90% of genes**, 0.44 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.97 against 0.22 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 95%.

label: tnaC
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the tnaC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor tnaC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,418 to 4,497 from dnaA. Read in 528 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying tnaC once); 41,712 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.44 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,689 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; shell 13,299 calls, named 80%, 0.83 bits; cloud 724 calls, named 18%, 3.38 bits. Outside an RGP 29,698 calls, named 95%, 0.22 bits; inside an RGP 12,014 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 17 fork, 21 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.22 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 95%); 12,014 of the 41,712 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 52 (yicJ, a fork column) 1.38 bits, RGP 57%; column 51 (setC, a fork column) 1.07 bits, RGP 51%; column 53 (yicI, a fork column) 1.06 bits, RGP 59%. The 18 columns (columns 13-18, 25-29 and 51-57) where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.55 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 90%, 0.41 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 42 spine columns: named 94%, 0.25 bits on average; the 38 fork and variable columns: named 86%, 0.64 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 52, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 14-17 (spine), RGP 91-92%; the least: column 36 (variable), RGP 1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-12 (13 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-11%. Genes: tnaC, mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "chromosomal replication initiator p…", dnaN, recF, gyrB, yidB "YidB family protein", yidA "sugar-phosphatase". named 88-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 1 (mnmE), named 88%; most hesitant at column 7 (dnaA), 0.89 bits.
[S2] 2. column 13 fork: share 71%, all S, RGP 83%. named 81%; 0.13 bits.
[S2.c13]    13: yidX S 71% "protein YidX"; also "lipoprotein" S 27%
[S3] 3. columns 14-17 (4 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all S, RGP 91-92%. Genes: dgoR, dgoK, dgoA, dgoD "galactonate dehydratase". named 91-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 14 (dgoR), named 91%; most hesitant at column 17 (dgoD), 0.20 bits.
[S4] 4. column 18 variable: share 89%, all S, RGP 75%. named 95%; 0.40 bits.
[S4.c18]    18: dgoT S 89%
[S5] 5. columns 19-24 (6 columns) spine: share 98-99.6%, all P, RGP 3-27%.
